title: Figure 7: Slit-imaging coincidence-free Ghost Interference setup for nonlocal signaling
description: Color optical schematic: an "Argon Ion Laser" (VLP 351 nm) pumps a BBO crystal; a "Polarizing Splitter" sends a VLP 702 nm photon through an IR pass filter and "Double Convex Lens, Focal Length = f" to "Image Slits" S2 with a switch and detectors D/combiner C, and an HLP 702 nm photon through "Object Slits" S1 to a "Camera." Small plots under the camera labeled "0" (interference fringes) and "1" (single hump) represent the signal states. The caption reads "Figure 7. Slit-Imaging Coincidence-Free Version of the Ghost Interference Experiment to Demonstrate Nonlocal Communication."
